summary: # Changelog ## 0.2.96 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.96 ## 0.2.95 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.95 ## 0.2.94 - Fixed `getContextUsage()` to include agents passed via `options.agents` in the `agents` breakdown - Fixed CJK and other multibyte text being corrupted with U+FFFD in stream-json input/output when chunk boundaries split a UTF-8 sequence - Fixed MCP server child processes not being cleaned up when an SDK `query()` session ends - Fixed a failed error-report write crashing the SDK process with `unhandledRejection`
